stories.title: Matiks raises $10 million from General Catalyst for brain games
stories.summary: Bengaluru social gaming startup Matiks has raised $10 million in a pre-Series A round led by General Catalyst, with upGrad founder Ronnie Screwvala joining. Users compete in maths, memory, logic and puzzle games. The round is about three times its last one, and the money funds a US push.

stories.title: Jagruti raises ₹28 crore to grow to 40 mental health centres
stories.summary: Pune's Jagruti Rehabilitation Centre, which runs residential mental health, addiction and dementia care centres, has raised ₹28 crore in its first institutional round, a Series A led by Alkemi Growth Capital. Started in 2008 as a 10-bed centre, it now has 19 and plans over 40 centres with 4,000 beds.

stories.title: CapGrid raises ₹50 crore at a ₹430 crore valuation
stories.summary: Delhi NCR manufacturing startup CapGrid has raised ₹50 crore in a pre-Series B round led by Hero Enterprise Venture Partners, valuing it at ₹430 crore, CEO Dheeraj Tiwari told Inc42. It will fund R&D into higher-end precision components and expansion into drone manufacturing and data centres.

stories.title: Bijnis renames itself Zorit and raises ₹27 crore
stories.summary: B2B quick commerce startup Zorit, formerly Bijnis, has raised nearly ₹27 crore in a round led by Sparrow Capital, with Info Edge, WaterBridge, Better Capital and angels including Anupam Mittal. It reports ₹120 crore in annualised sales. Info Edge's stake rises to 20.12 per cent.

stories.title: BITS Pilani alumni's Broccoli AI raises $52 million from Khosla
stories.summary: Broccoli AI, a San Francisco startup founded by BITS Pilani alumni AJ Jain and Aditya Ketkar, has raised $52 million across Series A and B rounds led by Khosla Ventures. It builds AI agents for plumbers, electricians and other home-service firms. 'AI does the office work,' Khosla's Samir Kaul said.

stories.title: QwikBuild raises $2.3 million and plans a Japan venture with its investor
stories.summary: Bengaluru enterprise AI startup QwikBuild has raised $2.3 million in a pre-seed round led by Tokyo-listed Globalway, with Blume Ventures, DeVC and Marsshot. Most of the money goes to a US team and Southeast Asia. A joint venture with Globalway to sell in Japan should start by end 2026.

stories.title: upliance.ai in talks to raise up to $4 million
stories.summary: D2C home appliance startup upliance.ai is in advanced talks to raise $3 million to $4 million in a Series A, sources told Inc42, with Khosla Ventures looking to invest further. It raised ₹34 crore in 2024 at a ₹143 crore valuation. Founders came from Ather Energy and Chaayos.

stories.title: Numour in talks to raise $3.1 million from Sharrp Ventures
stories.summary: Delhi NCR skincare brand Numour, which pairs formulations with beauty devices such as LED jars and sonic massagers, is in talks to raise about $3.1 million in a round led by Sharrp Ventures, sources told Inc42. Founded in 2025 by Divya Jain, it is backed by Indian Silicon Valley Capital.

stories.title: dubdub raises $1.3 million to turn the scroll into a quiz
stories.summary: dubdub, a swipe-based trivia and puzzle app, has raised a $1.3 million seed round led by 3one4 Capital, with Antler and Stellaris. Every swipe asks users to answer, guess or solve something across more than 20 categories, including cricket and Bollywood. It has crossed 20,000 downloads in about seven months.

stories.title: IIT Madras-incubated Viridian Ingni raises ₹1.47 crore for electric motors
stories.summary: Chennai deeptech startup Viridian Ingni Propulsion has raised ₹1.47 crore in a pre-seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures, plus ₹53.75 lakh in grants. It builds motors, controllers and firmware for EVs, drones and robots. The money takes it from prototypes to a pilot production line and certification.

stories.title: CopperPilot raises $390,000 for an AI that designs circuit boards
stories.summary: CopperPilot has raised $390,000 in a pre-seed round led by Neon Fund and launched Epsilon, the first version of its AI agent for designing electronic circuit boards. It says weekly active users grew 25-fold since August and more than 6,000 design tasks have run on the platform.

stories.title: Childcare startup Maasi raises ₹6 crore
stories.summary: Bengaluru childcare startup Maasi has raised ₹6 crore in a pre-seed round led by Better Capital with Antler India, plus angels including Rapido's Rishikesh SR and Shadowfax's Vaibhav Khandelwal. Founded last year, it connects families with trained home caregivers and will expand recruitment, training and technology.

stories.title: Travel startup Onto raises $1 million and refunds price drops
stories.summary: Bengaluru travel startup Onto has launched after raising $1 million in a pre-seed round led by Stargazer Fund, with White Venture Capital. Its first feature, Price Drop Refund, pays back the difference if an eligible hotel room gets cheaper after booking. It was founded in June 2026.

stories.title: Qiroko raises ₹1.5 crore after a bootstrapped first year
stories.summary: Bengaluru fashion accessories brand Qiroko has raised ₹1.5 crore in a pre-seed round led by ISV Capital. It claims an annualised revenue run rate of ₹6 crore within its first year, and will expand its watches and bags ranges through D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce.

stories.title: Sebastian Thrun's Dulo raises $130 million for AI engineering
stories.summary: Dulo, an AI engineering startup co-founded by Google X co-founder Sebastian Thrun and Adrian Aoun, has raised $130 million, The Information reported and Aoun confirmed on X. Investors include former Google CEO Eric Schmidt and early Google backer Ram Shriram. Thrun led the X programme that became Waymo.

stories.title: Powerlattice raises $86 million to cut AI chips' power demands
stories.summary: Powerlattice, a Vancouver, Washington, semiconductor startup building chips that reduce the power AI processors need, has raised $86 million of a targeted $111 million, an SEC filing shows. That nearly triples the $31 million it had raised before. Former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger sits on its board.

stories.title: Nevis raises $70 million for its wealth management AI
stories.summary: New York's Nevis, an AI operating system for wealth managers, has closed a $70 million Series B led by EQT Ventures, with Schwab joining as a strategic investor. It says platform assets rose to $700 billion from $50 billion this year and revenue grew more than 25-fold.

stories.title: &Truth raises a $70 million seed to prove code is safe
stories.summary: &Truth, a public benefit corporation founded in early 2026, has emerged from stealth with $70 million in seed funding. It is building what it calls a universal verification machine that reads code in any language and mathematically proves it safe, secure and correct. The seed round has grown up.

stories.title: Cyera talks to investors at a $20 billion valuation
stories.summary: Israeli cybersecurity startup Cyera has held preliminary talks to raise money at a $20 billion valuation, nearly double its last round four months ago, The Information reports via CTech. The talks are early and may not lead to a round. The company protects corporate data against AI-powered attacks.

stories.title: Infisical raises $40 million to keep secrets away from AI agents
stories.summary: Open-source secrets management startup Infisical has raised a $40 million Series B at a $600 million valuation, led by Elad Gil with Y Combinator and Gradient Ventures. The money backs Agent Vault, which sits between an AI agent and the services it calls so the agent never holds the keys.

stories.title: Argotec raises €50 million to build more small satellites
stories.summary: Italian smallsat maker Argotec has raised €50 million, led by NUO Space, to raise output from 52 satellites a year to 80. Founded in 2008, it built two microsatellites that flew with NASA's DART and Artemis I missions, and works on ESA and JAXA-ISRO programmes.

stories.title: Israel's Bites raises $40 million to train restaurant workers with AI
stories.summary: Israeli startup Bites, founded by former Tel Aviv restaurateur Eran Hefetz, has raised $40 million for an AI platform that trains frontline workers such as waiters and bartenders. Hefetz once co-owned Vicky Cristina. AI cannot replace the waiter yet, so it is teaching them instead.

stories.title: Phinity Labs raises $5.2 million for AI agents that design chips
stories.summary: Phinity Labs, led by Sonya Jin and Aadi Nashikkar, has come out of stealth with a $5.2 million seed round led by Uncork Capital, with Moxxie and angels including Jeff Dean. It builds AI agents that design computer chips from text prompts and tests designs with physical feedback.

stories.title: Kalshi's valuation nearly doubles to $40 billion
stories.summary: Prediction market Kalshi has seen its valuation nearly double to $40 billion in a matter of months on a $1 billion Series G co-led by Wellington and Sequoia, Finextra reports. The full piece is behind a login. The odds of that, someone presumably priced.

stories.title: India's PE and VC deals hit $8 billion in October, mostly one deal
stories.summary: Private equity and venture investments in India reached $8.02 billion in October, the highest this year, Venture Intelligence data show. A single $5.6 billion bank deal made up about 70 per cent. Deals fell to 106 from 125 in September. Five mega deals made up nearly 87 per cent.

stories.title: Indian startups raised $130.2 million this week, down 29 per cent
stories.summary: Indian tech startups raised $130.2 million between 26 and 30 October, down 29.2 per cent from $184 million the week before, Inc42's tracker shows. Deal count rose 88 per cent to 32 from 17. More cheques, smaller ones.

stories.title: LPs are happy to pile into the same two AI companies
stories.summary: Limited partners who back venture firms are feeling great, TechCrunch reports. OpenAI and Anthropic valuations rose so fast that nearly everyone piled into the same two companies, often inside the same firm, despite the convention of avoiding conflicting bets. The LPs seem unbothered by the concentration.

stories.title: Formation Bio raises a $600 million fund instead of another round
stories.summary: Venture-backed drug developer Formation Bio needed cash to acquire more medicines and raised a $600 million investment fund instead of a new venture round, The Wall Street Journal reports. It buys compounds, houses each in a newly formed company and takes them through clinical trials.

stories.title: Asia's startups raised $1.2 billion in week 44, led by FuriosaAI
stories.summary: Asian startups raised about $1.2 billion in equity and debt in week 44, Techloy reports, led by a $620 million Series D for South Korean AI chipmaker FuriosaAI. India produced 16 of the 27 rounds, while South Korea and China had the largest deals.

stories.title: TVS Capital files a ₹750 crore private credit fund
stories.summary: TVS Capital Funds has launched TVS Alts, targeting ₹750 crore for its first private credit fund with a ₹500 crore green shoe. The fund has been filed with SEBI and awaits approval. It plans secured loans of ₹40 crore to ₹100 crore. Insurers and banks are potential, unconfirmed investors.

stories.title: India can build rockets. Can its VCs fund the next one?
stories.summary: After Skyroot's Vikram-1 reached orbit in July, journalist Ashlee Vance asked on 22 October, 'Why are Indian VCs so afraid to take risk and make money?' Inc42 examines whether Indian venture capital is ready to back hardware and deep tech at scale. The question has been asked before.

stories.title: Ho Chi Minh City plans up to VND 1,800 billion more for its venture fund
stories.summary: Ho Chi Minh City is considering adding up to VND 1,800 billion, or VND 200 billion a year from 2027 to 2035, to its city venture capital fund, according to a draft resolution. With the initial VND 200 billion in 2026, state capital would reach VND 2,000 billion by 2035.

stories.title: Europe's venture gap is also a discovery problem
stories.summary: Europe's startup financing gap is real, but investors and companies also struggle to find each other, The European Business Review argues. A Danish climate startup and an Italian specialist investor could spend months relying on local advisers and fragmented databases without ever meeting.

stories.title: IPO-bound StockGro's profit triples to ₹113 crore
stories.summary: StockGro parent AssetGro Fintech, which filed confidentially for an IPO this month, reported FY26 profit of ₹113 crore against ₹34.6 crore, helped by a ₹14 crore net tax credit. Operating revenue doubled to ₹226.1 crore, 99.9 per cent of it from subscription fees.

stories.title: Ratnadeep Retail gets SEBI's nod for an IPO
stories.summary: Hyderabad food, grocery and value fashion retailer Ratnadeep Retail has SEBI approval for an IPO with a ₹400 crore fresh issue and an offer for sale of 1.49 crore promoter shares. It plans to spend ₹260 crore on new Ratnadeep and National Mart stores and ₹40 crore on debt.

stories.title: OPay raises $304 million in its NYSE listing at the bottom of the range
stories.summary: Nigeria-focused fintech OPay sold 16 million American depositary shares at $19 each in its New York Stock Exchange IPO, the bottom of its $19 to $21 range, Reuters reported. The listing comes during a selloff in tech and AI stocks that has led others to delay theirs.

stories.title: Salesforce reportedly buys Rune for $375 million
stories.summary: Salesforce has agreed to buy Rune Technologies, which builds AI software to help the US military predict supply needs and manage field logistics, for $375 million in cash and stock, Resilience Media reported. Rune, founded in 2024, had raised $30 million from investors including Andreessen Horowitz.

stories.title: Ather and Zetwerk lead new-age tech stocks higher
stories.summary: Of 69 new-age tech stocks Inc42 tracks, 40 rose this week. Ather Energy gained 26.8 per cent to ₹1,755.05 after its first quarterly net profit, and Zetwerk rose 18 per cent. CarTrade fell 22 per cent. Swiggy hit a fresh low. Combined market cap reached $160.94 billion.

stories.title: Reliance Retail wants JioMart profitable from FY28
stories.summary: Reliance Retail is expanding its dark store network and delivery speed in smaller cities while watching unit economics, CFO Dinesh Taluja said on an earnings call. Investments in dark stores and customer acquisition are expected to start contributing positively to profitability from next financial year.

stories.title: Swiggy's Toing raises questions about delivery profits
stories.summary: Analysts are asking whether Swiggy's affordable meal app Toing can add demand without diluting the core business, Mint reports. Swiggy says it could lift growth in its combined food delivery marketplace to 25 to 30 per cent against 18 to 20 per cent guidance for the core alone.

stories.title: Privacy-focused AI assistant Ollie is shutting down
stories.summary: Ollie, a startup building an AI assistant that respected user privacy, will shut down on 6 November, co-founder and CEO Bill Lennon said on X. It had a $7.5 million seed round led by Khosla Ventures, discussed in September. 'I'm really proud of what we accomplished,' Lennon said.

stories.title: Forensic audit points to an external scam behind Capillary's €3 million fraud
stories.summary: A KPMG forensic audit found the €3.04 million banking fraud at Capillary Technologies' Czech subsidiary was most consistent with an external payment diversion scam impersonating a senior executive and a lawyer. It found no malware or employee involvement, and could not rule out deepfake audio or video.

stories.title: Walmart probes Flipkart staff over alleged ₹150 crore kickbacks
stories.summary: Walmart has opened an investigation into allegations that Flipkart employees in its smartphones and luggage divisions took over ₹150 crore in kickbacks from vendors for better visibility, Moneycontrol reported. The probe is ongoing, and the extent of any wrongdoing has not been established.

stories.title: Fewer IIT and IIM graduates are starting companies
stories.summary: Just 79 IIT and 20 IIM alumni founded tech startups between January and August 2026, against 307 and 71 in all of 2025, Tracxn data collated for The Economic Times show. Tracxn notes the figures are not directly comparable. Overall startup formation in India keeps rising.

stories.title: Former Meta AI director Rohit Patel launches Ndoc to take on Office
stories.summary: Rohit Patel has left Meta after eight years to launch Ndoc, which brings presentations, written analysis and datasets into one connected environment. He told TechCrunch companies are 'basically attaching AI to spreadsheets' and said the approach 'kills my soul'. Spreadsheets have survived worse.

stories.title: Two 18-year-olds skip engineering entrance exams and raise $1.3 million
stories.summary: Naman Bansal and Shreyans Jain, both 18 and originally from India, have raised $1.3 million through SAFEs for their AI startup Manicule, in a round co-led by Y Combinator and Broom Ventures. They skipped university and competitive engineering entrance exams to build the company.

stories.title: Skyroot plans commercial launches from early 2027
stories.summary: After Vikram-1's first orbital launch in July, Hyderabad's Skyroot Aerospace plans full commercial launches from the first quarter of 2027 and one a month by the end of next year, co-founder Naga Bharath Daka told Business Standard. He sees a market for two a month in the long run.

stories.title: Zumutor bets on novel biologics in a generics country
stories.summary: Kavitha Iyer Rodrigues chose novel drug discovery over scaling a biosimilars business, Mint's Lab Rats series reports. 'Scale was not my cup of tea,' she said. Her Bengaluru-founded Zumutor's lead candidate, ZM008, is in phase 1 US trials, aimed at helping natural killer cells attack cancer.

stories.title: Mestastop takes its anti-metastasis drug to the US FDA
stories.summary: Bengaluru biotech Mestastop has begun the US FDA process for an Investigational New Drug application for a Phase 2 study of MSAP031, repurposed to delay metastasis. India's CDSCO has already approved a Phase II trial in post-surgical colorectal cancer patients. Aleon Pharma handles the regulatory work.

stories.title: A Michelin-recognised chef sells chole bhature in Dubai for ₹500
stories.summary: Indian-origin chef Pradeep Khullar has built a chole bhature business in Dubai, where he sells a plate for about ₹500, Mint reports. He grew up in Delhi's Rohini, where his mother ran a small tailoring boutique while holding a job to support the family.

stories.title: API Setu has government data and few takers
stories.summary: The Centre and states are setting up data governance committees to make government data more accessible, The Ken reports. Six years on, API Setu, the government's API marketplace, still struggles to attract developers and departments because of slow approvals and catalogue gaps. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Startups that decide what AI agents can do are drawing funding
stories.summary: Funding for European startups that secure AI agents has grown sixfold this year, and big security vendors are already buying them, Sifted reports. The full piece is for subscribers. The bouncer business, it seems, is hiring.
